edges.reason: Deployer msg.sender receives the entire initial supply in the DAce constructor.
Ownable constructor copies _msgSender() into _owner.
onlyOwner gate compares newComer with _msgSender(), so only the deployer-derived address satisfies the check.
newComer state variable is initialized from msg.sender at construction, granting the deployer privileged access.
Ownable constructor writes the deployer address into _owner.
Constructor reads _tTotal when minting the supply.
Constructor writes the full supply into _balances[_msgSender()].
approve delegates to the private _approve routine.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move balances.
transferFrom calls _approve to rewrite the sender allowance.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() both as spender lookup and as the new allowance target.
transfer calls _transfer.
transfer sends funds from the untrusted _msgSender() address.
_transfer debits and credits _balances entries.
_approve writes _allowances[ol][tt]; the written value depends on whether ol equals owner(), so a non-owner path silently zeroes the allowance.
_approve branches on ol != owner(), making allowance behavior depend on the privileged owner state variable.
Any caller whose address differs from owner() triggers the forced allowance reset branch.
allowance reads the nested _allowances mapping.
balanceOf reads _balances.
totalSupply returns _tTotal.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership clears _owner but leaves newComer untouched, so the onlyOwner gate keeps passing.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner but is private and thus unreachable.
transferOwnership would reassign _owner without updating newComer, preserving the deployer's privileged check.
Caller-controlled addresses flowing into Address.sendValue reach an unchecked low-level value transfer.
Caller-controlled target/data flowing into Address._functionCallWithValue reach an external call before state finalization.
ol parameter feeds the zero-address require and the owner comparison inside _approve.
tt parameter feeds the zero-address require and the allowance mapping key inside _approve.
amount parameter is stored into _allowances in the owner branch.
spender parameter is forwarded to _approve from approve.
amount parameter is forwarded to _approve from approve.
sender parameter is passed to _transfer and used as allowance key in transferFrom.
recipient parameter is passed to _transfer in transferFrom.
amount parameter is subtracted from the allowance via SafeMath.sub in transferFrom.
recipient parameter is passed to _transfer in transfer.
amount parameter is passed to _transfer in transfer.
sender parameter indexes the debited _balances entry.
recipient parameter indexes the credited _balances entry.
amount parameter is the value moved by _transfer.
account parameter is the lookup key for _balances in balanceOf.
owner parameter is the outer key read by allowance.
spender parameter is the inner key read by allowance.
newOwner parameter is validated against address(0) and would replace the privileged owner.
Local msgSender copy is stored into _owner during the Ownable constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: ol is only meaningful as the owner argument of _approve and controls the owner comparison branch.
tt is only used as the spender key when _approve writes _allowances.
amount is only stored into _allowances by the owner branch of _approve.
spender is forwarded from approve to _approve and has no standalone state.
amount is forwarded from approve to _approve and has no standalone state.
sender is only consumed by _transfer and the allowance subtraction inside transferFrom.
recipient is only forwarded to _transfer from transferFrom.
amount is only used for the _transfer call and the SafeMath allowance subtraction.
recipient is only forwarded to _transfer from transfer.
amount is only forwarded to _transfer from transfer.
sender is only an index into _balances inside _transfer.
recipient is only an index into _balances inside _transfer.
amount is only the SafeMath-adjusted value moved inside _transfer.
account is only the read key for _balances in balanceOf.
owner is only the outer read key for _allowances in allowance.
spender is only the inner read key for _allowances in allowance.
newOwner is only validated and assigned inside the transferOwnership function.
msgSender is a temporary local used only to write _owner during construction.
